description.zh: 服务描述，长度最长为256字符。
description.en: Service description, with a maximum length of 256 characters.

description.zh:
数据源类型，取值：

- mysql/postgresql

- hdfs/hive
description.en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

*   mysql

- postgresql

*   hdfs

- hive
When HadoopCreateType is Emr, the value of this field is the EMR instance ID.

description.zh: Hadoop hdfs-site.xml文件内容。在选择开通HDFS外表时，该字段必填。
description.en: The content of the Hadoop hdfs-site.xml file. This parameter must be specified when DataSourceType is set to HDFS.
The content of the Hadoop core-site.xml file.

description.zh:
外部服务创建类型：

- emr：emr实例

- selfCreate：自建
description.en:
The type of the external service. Valid values:

*   emr: E-MapReduce (EMR) Hadoop cluster.
*   selfCreate: self-managed Hadoop cluster.

description.zh: Hadoop集群源节点在/etc/hosts文件中的地址和hostname。
description.en: The IP address and hostname of the Hadoop cluster (data source) in the /etc/hosts file.

description.zh: Hadoop hive-site.xml文件内容。在选择开通HIVE外表时，该字段必填。
description.en: The content of the Hadoop hive-site.xml file. This parameter must be specified when DataSourceType is set to Hive.

description.zh: Hadoop mapred-site.xml文件内容。在选择开通HDFS外表时，该字段必填。
description.en: The content of the Hadoop mapred-site.xml file. This parameter must be specified when DataSourceType is set to HDFS.

description.zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~86912~~)接口查看可用的地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~86912~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: Hadoop yarn-site.xml文件内容。在选择开通HDFS外表时，该字段必填。
description.en: The content of the Hadoop yarn-site.xml file. This parameter must be specified when DataSourceType is set to HDFS.
